identity.title: Your identity could not be verified
identity.approvalDescription: You cannot claim, process or approve tasks. Contact your site administrator to verify your account identity.
identity.badCaseDescription: You cannot add, label or dismiss cases. Contact your site administrator to verify your account identity.
identity.orderDraftDescription: You cannot confirm, cancel or edit order drafts. Contact your site administrator to verify your account identity.

approval.unavailableDescription: Tasks and statistics could not be loaded. An empty list does not mean all tasks are complete. Contact your site administrator.

badCase.unavailableDescription: The case queue and statistics could not be loaded. An empty list or zero values do not mean the queue is complete. Contact your site administrator.

orderDraft.unavailableDescription: Order drafts and statistics could not be loaded. An empty list does not mean there are no drafts awaiting confirmation. Contact your site administrator.
orderDraft.detailUnavailableDescription: This order draft cannot currently be loaded or processed, so its status is unconfirmed. Contact your site administrator.
orderDraft.temporaryStorageWarning: Drafts are currently stored temporarily and may be unavailable after a service interruption. Contact your site administrator to verify their storage status.
orderDraft.countsUnavailable: Draft counts have not been loaded. The number of pending drafts is unknown.
orderDraft.serviceWarning: The order draft service has a problem that may affect draft creation or saving. Contact your site administrator before continuing.
orderDraft.listLimitHint: The returned draft count has reached the limit. More drafts may be available. Increase the limit (up to 200) or narrow the ownership filter.
orderDraft.provisionalOrderWarning: The draft is confirmed, but a formal order has not been created. Reference {orderId} is temporary. Contact your site administrator to verify and create the order.
orderDraft.productNameHint: If this customer already has a pending draft for the same product, process that draft first.
orderDraft.editHint: Only changed values are saved. Quantity must be at least 1 and price cannot be negative. To discard a draft, choose Cancel draft. Saving updates the draft and total.

insight.existingRecordsSource: Generated from existing customer records (no AI model)
insight.confirmDescription: Confirming executes the suggested actions and updates records. Review the evidence and actions first.

email.providerReferenceDescription: Look up SMTP addresses, ports and authentication requirements, then configure a sender account. Follow the provider's current instructions for exact settings.

knowledge.label: RAG knowledge base
knowledge.description: A RAG knowledge base is a document collection used for import and retrieval. Select the collection you want to work with.
knowledge.required: Select the target RAG knowledge base first.
knowledge.queryRequired: Select a RAG knowledge base and enter a query.
knowledge.previewEmpty: Select a RAG knowledge base and a file (or paste JSON), then choose Preview parsed results.
